answer: Standing is a haven that only counts when it is worked in: each epoch’s work must be done in a safe place — a place where the work is protected, where it cannot be copied or stolen — an atlas only counts when it maps the haven, and a trellis only counts when it grows inside it. A farm of a thousand fakes works in no haven, out in the open where anyone can copy it, so their haven never counts, and one epoch of working in the open adds nothing.
